content.md: **Environment Configuration** — Offline lesson 43 in the Web Essentials track (advanced).

This lesson covers **Environment Configuration** as part of Web Essentials. DevPath bundles the reading and quiz offline; run server-side PHP, SQL engines, or Python only on your computer when a lesson says to practice locally.

- Prefer clarity and small steps over clever shortcuts.
- Validate on the **server** for anything security-sensitive (even when you also validate in the browser).
- Keep secrets out of source control and client-side code.
Skipping validation, copying outdated examples, or assuming every SQL dialect behaves exactly like MySQL.
